legal.privacySubtitle: Last updated July 2026. Plain-language version below — the short of it: your budget is yours, and it stays that way.
legal.termsSubtitle: Last updated July 2026. These terms cover how you can use Flousy, and what you can expect from us.
legal.authoritativeNotice: Note: The English version of this document is the legally authoritative version.

privacy.s1Body: We collect the information you give us directly: your email address, the income, expenses, categories and goals you enter, and basic account preferences like your currency and display settings. We do not ask for bank logins, card numbers, or account numbers of any kind.
privacy.s2Body: Your budgeting data is used to power the app itself — to show your balances, calculate your budget, and sync your information across your devices. We do not use your financial data to build advertising profiles, and we do not sell it to third parties.
privacy.s3Body: Only you can access your budget. Our systems are built so that your account's data is isolated from every other account, and our team accesses individual data only when needed to fix a problem you've reported.
privacy.s4Body: We may use limited, privacy-respecting analytics to understand how the app is used overall (for example, which features are popular). This is aggregated and anonymized, and is off by default until you agree to it.
privacy.s5Body: We keep your data for as long as your account is active. If you delete your account, your profile, budgets, and goals are permanently removed from our systems.
privacy.s6Body: You can export your budgeting history as a spreadsheet at any time from Settings. You can also delete your account and all associated data permanently, whenever you like — no need to contact support.
privacy.s7Body: If we make meaningful changes to how we handle your data, we'll let you know in the app before the changes take effect.
privacy.s8Body: Questions about this policy or your data? Reach out any time from our Contact page.

terms.s1Body: By creating an account, you agree to use Flousy for its intended purpose — tracking your personal budget. You're responsible for keeping your login details secure and for the accuracy of the information you enter.
terms.s2Body: You must be able to legally enter into these terms to use Flousy. One account is for one person's budget; if you need a shared or household budget, look out for that feature on our roadmap.
terms.s3Body: Flousy's core features are free to use, with no time limit. Flousy Pro is an optional paid upgrade that unlocks additional features. Pro subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled, and you can cancel anytime from Settings.
terms.s4Body: Flousy is a budgeting and tracking tool. It is not a bank, does not move real money on your behalf, and does not provide financial, investment, or tax advice. Decisions about your finances remain entirely your own.
terms.s5Body: Please don't use Flousy to store information that isn't yours, to attempt to access other users' accounts, or to interfere with the normal operation of the app.
terms.s6Body: You can cancel a Pro subscription or delete your account entirely at any time from Settings. Deleting your account permanently removes your data from our systems.
terms.s7Body: We may add, change, or remove features over time as Flousy improves. We'll do our best to communicate meaningful changes in advance.
terms.s8Body: Flousy is provided "as is." While we work hard to keep your data accurate and available, we can't guarantee the service will be uninterrupted or error-free, and we aren't liable for financial decisions made using the app.
terms.s9Body: Questions about these terms? Reach out from our Contact page.

about.title: Money you can finally make sense of.
about.subtitle: Flousy started from a simple frustration: budgeting apps that tell you what you spent, but never help you understand why your money still runs out.
about.s1Body: Every budgeting question really comes down to two things: what is this money for, and where does it actually sit right now? Most apps mix the two together until neither makes sense. Flousy keeps them separate, so you always know both — without spreadsheets, without guesswork.
about.s2Body: We designed Flousy for real budgets — the cash in your wallet, the money sitting at home, and whatever's left in the bank. No bank connections required, no complicated setup. Just add your income, pick a style that fits how you think about money, and start logging as you go.
about.s3Title: Free to start, honest about the rest
about.s3Body: The core of Flousy — tracking, budgeting styles, savings goals — is free, and always will be. Flousy Pro exists for people who want a deeper look at their habits over time. We'll never hide basic budgeting behind a paywall.
about.s4Body: Budgeting means sharing personal details about your life. We take that seriously: your data is private to your account, never sold, and yours to export or delete whenever you choose.

help.title: Questions, answered.
help.subtitle: Can't find what you're looking for? Reach out and we'll get back to you.

faqs.question: Do I need to connect my bank account?
faqs.answer: No. Flousy never asks for your bank login, card number, or account number. You add your income and expenses yourself, and choose which place — bank, home, or wallet — each one belongs to.

faqs.question: How does Flousy decide my budget?
faqs.answer: You pick a budgeting style that fits how you think about money. Flousy then splits your income into needs, wants, and savings automatically. You can switch styles at any time, and your categories adjust to match.

faqs.question: What's the difference between 'what it's for' and 'where it is'?
faqs.answer: Your budget decides what your money is for — rent is a need, dinner out is a want. Separately, Flousy tracks where that money actually sits — in your bank, at home, or in your wallet. Keeping these separate means your numbers always make sense.

faqs.question: Can I use more than one currency?
faqs.answer: Yes. Flousy supports 12 currencies, and you can switch your display currency anytime from Settings.

faqs.question: What happens if I delete an expense by mistake?
faqs.answer: The money is returned to wherever it came from, instantly and exactly. Nothing about your balances is ever left out of sync.

faqs.question: What do I get with Flousy Pro?
faqs.answer: Pro adds spending trends over time, automatic recurring bills, overspending alerts, and the ability to import your past spending in one go — on top of everything in the free plan.

faqs.question: Can I export my data?
faqs.answer: Yes, anytime. Head to Settings to download your full budgeting history as a spreadsheet.

faqs.question: How do I delete my account?
faqs.answer: You can permanently delete your account and all of your data from Settings, with no need to contact support.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.subtitle: Last updated July 2026. A short, honest explanation of the handful of cookies Flousy uses.

sections.title: 1. What cookies we use
sections.body: Flousy uses a small number of cookies and local storage entries to keep you signed in, remember your preferences (like currency and dark mode), and keep the app working smoothly between visits.

sections.title: 2. Essential cookies
sections.body: These are required for the app to function — for example, staying logged into your account. You can't opt out of these without losing the ability to use Flousy.

sections.title: 3. Optional analytics
sections.body: If enabled, we may use privacy-respecting analytics cookies to understand overall usage patterns, like which pages or features are most used. These don't track you across other websites, and are off unless you've agreed to them.

sections.title: 4. No advertising cookies
sections.body: Flousy does not use advertising or cross-site tracking cookies. We're not in the business of selling attention or data.

sections.title: 5. Managing cookies
sections.body: You can control or clear cookies through your browser settings at any time. Note that blocking essential cookies may prevent Flousy from working properly.
